verdict.rationale: Deel's own pages say it provides documentation and guidance to include spouses and children, and lists visa application support for dependents, so dependent filings are part of the service. However, the specific dependent categories in the story are never named, and dependent work authorization is not addressed. missing for 10: explicit O-3 and H-4 dependent visa coverage, spousal work authorization (e.g. EAD) support, dependent pricing/scope details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service

citations.quote: We provide the necessary documentation and guidance to include spouses and children.
Provide visa application support for dependents
